title: Charred bolt
content:
# Charred bolt

Internal ID: BoltCharred | Type: Bolts | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Charred bone x2, Ashwood x8, Feathers x2

# Introduction

Charred bolts are ammunition for crossbows and are the next direct upgrade from Carapace bolts.

## Availability

• It is unlocked after acquiring Charred bone and Ashwood from the Ashlands and is crafted at a Black forge.

Categorias: Weapons, Black forge recipes, Bolts
